QuestInfo.name: [Alliance Mission] Expedition Mission - Alliance Reinforcements
QuestInfo.1:
The Alliance's reinforcements have arrived. Work with them to exterminate monsters and push back against the giant. When the mission ends, report back to #b#p3003564##k to complete the Expedition Mission.

Reinforcements will arrive as you eliminate monsters. The more support troops there are, the stronger the #breinforcement effects#k will be. However, reinforcements will not arrive right after the giant uses the Light of Annihilation.

#rThis mission is extremely difficult and dangerous. Be especially wary of the giant's Light of Annihilation and Light of Judgment attacks.#k
QuestInfo.2: The Expedition Mission was successful, thanks to the Alliance's reinforcements. However...
